name: Fothad Canainne

attributes.attribute: legend partly lost into that of Fionn

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fothad Canainne is an Irish hero. He is one of three brothers. He is linked with the western province of Connacht and the eastern one of Leinster. Much of his story has become part of the tale of the hero Fionn. Some read him as a dim old god, perhaps a fire god.

okr.objective: Fothad Canainne is a hero of two provinces.
key_results: Fothad Canainne is one of three brothers.
He is linked with Connacht and Leinster.
